title: Stage A2 Dependency-Temporal Graph & Temporal Message Passing Contract (Amended V1.3)
description: Strict, raw-grounded specification for causal temporal graph construction, entity typing, message passing, target-leakage masking semantics, and execution scope bound to SPL-HDFS-001 split authority and millisecond timestamps.

ineligible_datasets.reason: BGL raw logs represent single-node localized telemetry alerts without extractable inter-entity interaction destinations. Excluded to prevent fabricated topology.

predict_before_update.rule: For any interaction event e_t = (v, u, r, t, x_e), all auxiliary SSL predictions (L_rel, L_node, L_time) must evaluate strictly on node memory states h_v(t-) and h_u(t-) BEFORE applying the memory update for e_t.

future_neighbor_firewall.rule: Neighborhood queries at time t must restrict edges strictly to E_{<t}. Static whole-timeline graph construction is strictly prohibited.

timestamp_tie_breaking.rule: Events are ordered strictly by exact UTC epoch timestamp (with millisecond precision) followed deterministically by raw_line_index in the raw audit stream.

split_memory_boundary_policy.rule: Upon transitioning from Train to Validation, all node dynamic memory states and last interaction timestamps are strictly reset to h_init = 0 and None, ensuring zero cross-split hidden state leakage.

entity_vocabulary_scope.rule: Node entity vocabulary is fit exclusively on the Train split. Unseen nodes in Validation receive <UNK_NODE> embedding combined with fixed entity type embedding. High-cardinality identity hashing is prohibited.

negative_sampling.rule: Canonical objective L_graph optimizes masked relation classification (L_rel) over known interaction pairs (v, u); negative destination sampling is excluded to maintain minimal, unbloated objective consistency.

masked_relation_prediction.rule: When event relation r is masked, the relation classification head receives strictly [h_v(t-) || h_u(t-) || phi(delta_t)]. The true relation embedding is withheld until post-loss memory update.

masked_node_reconstruction.rule: Node reconstruction head predicts x_v_fixed_priv strictly from h_v(t-). Target attributes are never passed into or concatenated with the reconstruction head input.

multi_edge_policy.rule: Every timestamped interaction event between node pairs is preserved in chronological order. Node historical edge buffers maintain at most 64 most recent interaction tuples (v, r, t, e_feat) in strictly causal FIFO order.
